recipes.name: Chive & Onion Whipped Tofu Toast
instructions: Add the whipped tofu ingredients to a small food processor. Blend until smooth.
Add the oil to a large pan over medium-high heat. Toast the bread until golden on both sides.
Spread a generous amount of whipped tofu on the toasted bread.
Top with tomato slices and basil. Optionally, finish with a drizzle of olive oil, a sprinkle of salt, and cracked pepper. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage The tofu spread can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
